name: How long does a kitchen cabinet replacement take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen cabinet replacement take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full kitchen cabinet replacement typically takes between three to five business days for physical tear-out and installation. However, the total project duration depends heavily on material lead times. Stock cabinets may arrive within a week or two, whereas semi-custom or custom cabinetry can take four to ten weeks to manufacture and ship. Once on-site, our crew removes old boxes, checks walls and floors for level, fastens new cabinets securely into studs, and installs trim and hardware before countertop measurement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Physical removal and installation usually take 3 to 5 days, though ordering and manufacturing cabinetry beforehand can take 2 to 10 weeks depending on custom options.
